snippet.title: Call of Duty Frontlines | COD4 Mod
snippet.description:
Download | http://www.mods.hajas.org
Play @ cod4.bloodculture.com.br every sunday @ 20h GMT-3
Just click in the Frontlines menu JOIN GLOBAL WAR SERVER

Frontlines is the biggest mod ever created to Call of Duty series and brings 28 gametypes, 11 weapons modes, Help Mode, the famous War Server, HER for the realism fans with lots of Blood and Gore, an Intelligent Server and many other new features, NEVER done to a FPS game before. More info and download at http://www.mods.hajas.org
